scope: Current 6.18 core memory, scheduling and power adaptations
evidence_note: Links identify verifiable public code, policy baselines and upstream commits. Runtime controls and compatibility adaptations are described separately from source imports.

changes.name_zh: PSCI 进空闲前重查调度
changes.origin_en: Linux/ACK PSCI idle driver. The linked file establishes the public code baseline for the pre-idle scheduling check.
changes.origin_zh: Linux / ACK 的 PSCI idle 驱动；链接提供进入空闲前重查调度的公开代码基线。
changes.adaptation_en: Check need_resched before CPU PM/firmware entry in both ordinary and domain idle paths; exclude suspend-to-idle from the domain shortcut.
changes.adaptation_zh: 普通 idle 和域 idle 两条路径均在 CPU PM / 固件调用前检查 need_resched；域路径的 suspend-to-idle 不提前退出。
changes.purpose_zh: 空闲记账期间若有新任务唤醒，浅空闲和电源域空闲两条入口都重查调度，避免白做 CPU PM / PSCI 进出；保留 s2idle 语义
changes.purpose_en: Recheck pending work after idle bookkeeping in both CPU and power-domain entry paths, avoiding unnecessary CPU PM/PSCI transitions; preserve s2idle semantics

changes.origin_en: ACK EROFS creates per-CPU decompression workers with sched_set_fifo_low; the linked source provides the code baseline.
changes.origin_zh: ACK EROFS 通过 sched_set_fifo_low 设置每 CPU 解压线程优先级；链接提供对应公开代码基线。
changes.adaptation_en: Expose a bounded runtime FIFO-priority parameter, default 3, and update existing workers under CPU-hotplug protection.
changes.adaptation_zh: 增加有界的运行时 FIFO 优先级参数，默认 3；在 CPU 热插拔保护下更新现有线程。
changes.purpose_zh: 文件读取等待解压时，让解压线程少排队：FIFO 优先级由 1 提到 3，可运行时调整
changes.purpose_en: Reduce decompression-worker queueing on file reads by raising FIFO priority from 1 to 3, adjustable at runtime

changes.name_zh: Binder 调试类别编译过滤
changes.origin_en: ACK binder_debug and its default debug mask provide the public code baseline for filtering debug categories.
changes.origin_zh: ACK 的 binder_debug 与默认调试掩码提供调试类别过滤的公开代码基线。
changes.adaptation_en: Compile out normally disabled classes, retaining default error classes; implement the filter against ACK.
changes.adaptation_zh: 仅编译裁去默认关闭的类别，保留默认错误类别；按 ACK 实现过滤。
changes.purpose_zh: 将默认关闭的调试类别在编译时裁去，减少 Binder 事务与加锁路径的无用调用；保留默认错误输出
changes.purpose_en: Compile out default-disabled debug categories to remove calls from Binder transactions and lock paths; retain default error output

changes.name_zh: loop 高优先级工作线程
changes.origin_en: OnePlus oplus_wq_dynamic_priority explicitly includes WQ_HIGHPRI for loop queues. Linux v5.12 also used a MIN_NICE loop worker.
changes.origin_zh: 一加 oplus_wq_dynamic_priority 明确为 loop 队列加入 WQ_HIGHPRI；Linux v5.12 的 loop 专用线程也使用 MIN_NICE。
changes.adaptation_en: Set the flag at queue creation, expose loop.hipri_wq and the existing workqueue sysfs controls; do not import the OnePlus scheduler/probe integration.
changes.adaptation_zh: 在创建队列处设置标志，增加 loop.hipri_wq 并开放工作队列 sysfs；未搬入一加的调度器 / 探针集成。
changes.purpose_zh: APEX 等 loop 文件读取经过的工作队列使用高优先级，减少与普通后台任务排队；保留开关
changes.purpose_en: Give loop workers used by APEX and other reads higher priority to reduce queueing behind ordinary background work; retain a switch

changes.origin_en: ACK sync_file ioctl implementation provides the public code baseline for fence-information queries.
changes.origin_zh: ACK 的 sync_file ioctl 实现提供 fence 信息查询的公开代码基线。
changes.adaptation_en: Fill each record on the stack, preserve traversal/refcount handling, and make omitted names switchable through sync_file.omit_names.
changes.adaptation_zh: 逐条在栈上填写记录，保留遍历 / 引用处理，通过 sync_file.omit_names 控制名称省略。
changes.purpose_zh: 逐条在栈上生成 fence 信息，省掉查询数组分配，默认省略调试名称，减少每帧重复工作
changes.purpose_en: Build fence records on the stack, remove query-array allocation and omit debug names by default to reduce repeated per-frame work

changes.origin_en: OnePlus zram_opt bypasses direct-reclaim throttling for RT/high-priority/UX tasks through android_vh_throttle_direct_reclaim_bypass.
changes.origin_zh: 一加 zram_opt 通过 android_vh_throttle_direct_reclaim_bypass，让实时 / 高优先级 / UX 任务绕过直接回收节流。
changes.adaptation_en: Use RT policy or negative nice as the local eligibility rule, with vm.throttle_exempt and a counter; this does not implement OnePlus UX tagging.
changes.adaptation_zh: 当前以实时策略或负 nice 判断，增加 vm.throttle_exempt 与计数；未实现一加 UX 标记体系。
changes.purpose_zh: 内存紧张时让实时 / 负 nice 任务绕过直接回收的节流等待，避免关键线程跟着停顿；可关闭并计数
changes.purpose_en: Let RT/negative-nice tasks bypass direct-reclaim throttling under memory pressure; expose a switch and counter

changes.origin_en: OnePlus SM8550 zram_opt, CONFIG_OPLUS_OOM_REAPER_OPT: request the OOM reaper above 32 MiB anonymous memory plus swap for selected killers.
changes.origin_zh: 一加 SM8550 zram_opt 的 CONFIG_OPLUS_OOM_REAPER_OPT：对特定杀进程服务发出的请求，在匿名页加 swap 超过 32 MiB 时调用 OOM 回收器。
changes.adaptation_en: Expose vm.reap_killed_mb, apply to qualifying cross-process SIGKILL without a killer-name allowlist, and keep task_will_free_mem checks and vendor-hook precedence.
changes.adaptation_zh: 增加 vm.reap_killed_mb；适用于满足条件的跨进程 SIGKILL，不限定发信号者名称，保留 task_will_free_mem 检查及 vendor 钩子优先级。
changes.purpose_zh: 被 SIGKILL 的进程占用匿名内存加 swap 超过默认 32 MiB 时，提前交给 OOM 回收器释放；阈值可调
changes.purpose_en: Send eligible SIGKILL victims with more than 32 MiB of anonymous memory plus swap to the OOM reaper sooner; make the threshold tunable

changes.name_zh: 去掉冗余 NOHZ CPU 计数
changes.origin_en: Linux scheduler series by Shrikanth Hegde: move the CPU check, adjust the branch, then replace nohz.nr_cpus with cpumask weight.
changes.origin_zh: Linux 调度器中 Shrikanth Hegde 的系列改动：后移 CPU 检查、调整分支，再以 cpumask 权重取代 nohz.nr_cpus。
changes.adaptation_en: Adapt the three upstream changes to the ACK 6.18 scheduler layout.
changes.adaptation_zh: 按 ACK 6.18 的调度器布局回移这三笔上游改动。
changes.purpose_zh: 用现有空闲 CPU 掩码代替全局原子计数，减少各核进出空闲时对同一缓存行的争用
changes.purpose_en: Use the existing idle-CPU mask instead of a global atomic count, reducing shared-cacheline contention on idle entry/exit

changes.origin_en: Linux scheduler changes by Shubhang Kaushik: update avg_idle when leaving idle and skip updates without a valid idle_stamp.
changes.origin_zh: Linux 调度器中 Shubhang Kaushik 的改动：离开 idle 时更新 avg_idle，并跳过没有有效 idle_stamp 的更新。
changes.adaptation_en: Backport the accounting location and valid-stamp guard to ACK 6.18.
changes.adaptation_zh: 回移统计位置与有效时间戳保护，适配 ACK 6.18。
changes.purpose_zh: 在离开空闲时更新统计，覆盖迁移 / fork 等路径，避免把忙碌时间误算为空闲并影响均衡判断
changes.purpose_en: Update statistics on idle exit, covering migration/fork paths and preventing busy time from being counted as idle in balancing decisions

changes.name_zh: 提前停止反向映射扫描
changes.origin_en: Huawei CONFIG_STOP_PAGE_REF, mm/stop_page_referencing.c from the Huawei Kirin 9000 kernel open-source release; the rule is reimplemented here, no file is imported.
changes.origin_zh: 华为 CONFIG_STOP_PAGE_REF，出自华为麒麟 9000 内核开源发布中的 mm/stop_page_referencing.c；此处重新实现该规则，未导入其文件。
changes.adaptation_en: Reimplement the settled-decision rule for folios/classic LRU, retain exported folio_referenced ABI, and use randomized full walks rather than Huawei page flags.
changes.adaptation_zh: 按 folio / 经典 LRU 重写“结论已定就停止”的规则，保留导出的 folio_referenced ABI；用随机完整扫描代替华为页标志方案。

sources.label: Huawei Kirin 9000 kernel open-source release, mm/stop_page_referencing.c
sources.role: algorithm reference (vendor open-source release; no link)

changes.purpose_zh: 页的活跃性结论已确定时提前结束反向映射扫描，减少回收遍历；适配 folio / 经典 LRU 并保留 ABI
changes.purpose_en: Stop reverse-map walks once the page-activity decision is settled; adapt to folios/classic LRU while retaining ABI

changes.origin_en: Xiaomi MiCode spring-v-oss mi_rmap_efficiency: default mapcount threshold 32, with pressure-dependent protection and a 1/16 skipped-page limit.
changes.origin_zh: 小米 MiCode spring-v-oss 的 mi_rmap_efficiency：默认 mapcount 阈值 32，包含随回收压力变化的保护及 1/16 跳过上限。
changes.adaptation_en: Use the high-mapcount rule in classic-LRU activation/ageing paths and keep a pressure cap; do not reproduce every dynamic-threshold tier of Xiaomi policy.
changes.adaptation_zh: 在经典 LRU 的激活 / 老化路径采用高 mapcount 规则并保留压力上限；没有完整复制小米的所有动态阈值档位。
changes.purpose_zh: 默认将映射计数至少 32 的共享页视为活跃，减少反复遍历和回收公共页；保留压力上限
changes.purpose_en: Treat pages with at least 32 mappings as active by default, reducing repeated walks and reclaim of shared pages; retain a pressure cap

changes.origin_en: LZ4 upstream 1.10.1 at fixed revision 83376b665fe6742171407350bb51e963215d6088; the kernel decoder baseline is based on 1.8.3.
changes.adaptation_en: Keep kernel-facing wrappers/exports, adapt 6.18 parameter names/include paths, and disable the 64-byte wild-copy path for in-place decompression safety.
changes.adaptation_zh: 保留内核接口封装 / 导出，适配 6.18 参数名和 include 路径；禁用 64 字节 wild-copy 路径以保护原地解压。
changes.purpose_zh: 以 1.10.1 C 实现更新原有 1.8.3 解压代码；禁用 arm64 的 64 字节超前拷贝，保留 32 字节路径以保护 EROFS 原地解压，并适配模块 ABI
changes.purpose_en: Update the 1.8.3-based decoder to upstream 1.10.1 C; disable arm64 64-byte wild copies and retain the 32-byte path for EROFS in-place safety, with module ABI adaptation

changes.name_zh: 唤醒锁 / 闹钟保持时间
changes.origin_en: Project policy: untimed wakelocks written through /sys/power/wake_lock expire after 500 ms, and the alarm timer holds its wakeup source until 5 ms after a due alarm instead of a fixed two seconds. Both act on upstream PM wakelock and alarmtimer code.
changes.origin_zh: 本项目策略：经 /sys/power/wake_lock 写入、未给时限的唤醒锁 500 ms 后到期；闹钟定时器只把唤醒源保持到到期后 5 ms，而不是固定 2 秒。两者作用于上游的 PM 唤醒锁与 alarmtimer 代码。
changes.adaptation_en: Implemented as reversible runtime parameters (wakelock.untimed_ms, alarmtimer.short_hold) with bounded overdue-alarm arithmetic.
changes.adaptation_zh: 实现为可恢复的运行时参数（wakelock.untimed_ms、alarmtimer.short_hold），并约束过期闹钟的时间运算。
changes.purpose_zh: 无时限唤醒锁默认 500 ms 到期，闹钟的额外保持缩至响后 5 ms，减少不必要的清醒时间；参数可恢复
changes.purpose_en: Default untimed wakelocks to 500 ms and shorten alarm hold to 5 ms past firing, reducing unnecessary awake time; expose reversible parameters

changes.origin_en: This project's implementation on the upstream wakeup-source code: named wakeup sources in a built-in or user list are not activated. Interface: /sys/devices/virtual/misc/wakelock_blocker (wakelock_blocker, wakelock_blocker_default, debug, version 1.0.0).
changes.origin_zh: 本项目在上游唤醒源代码上的实现：内置名单或用户名单中的唤醒源不再被激活。接口：/sys/devices/virtual/misc/wakelock_blocker（wakelock_blocker、wakelock_blocker_default、debug、version 1.0.0）。
changes.adaptation_en: Lists are parsed when written and swapped under RCU, with a first-character prefilter; the selected default names are DEFAULT_LIST in the linked implementation.
changes.adaptation_zh: 名单在写入时解析、以 RCU 替换，并按首字符预筛；选用的默认名称即实现链接中的 DEFAULT_LIST。
changes.purpose_zh: 按可调名称名单过滤唤醒保持，RCU 管理名单并预筛前缀，减少热点查表；支持清空名单恢复
changes.purpose_en: Filter wake holds through configurable name lists, with RCU management and prefix prefiltering; clear the lists to restore behavior

changes.origin_en: Linux/ACK zram already provides multiple compression algorithms, idle marking and recompression. These mechanisms belong to upstream zram.
changes.origin_zh: Linux / ACK zram 已提供多压缩算法、idle 标记和重压缩机制；这些基础能力来自上游 zram。
changes.adaptation_en: Add the automatic policy: LZ4 primary, ZSTD recompression, default 16 GiB size, 600-second awake interval, freezer/suspend cooperation and runtime controls. No external patch for this exact orchestration was established.
changes.adaptation_zh: 新增自动执行策略：LZ4 主算法、ZSTD 重压缩、默认 16 GiB、唤醒状态下间隔 600 秒、freezer / 挂起协作及运行时控制。未确认这套完整自动策略存在对应的外部公开补丁。
changes.purpose_zh: LZ4 处理热路径，冷页转用 ZSTD；默认 16 GiB，清醒时每 600 秒重压缩，并配合 freezer / 挂起
changes.purpose_en: Use LZ4 on the hot path and ZSTD for cold pages; default to 16 GiB with 600-second awake-time recompression and freezer/suspend cooperation

changes.origin_zh: Linux KFENCE 可延迟定时器；采用固定 ACK 已有实现。
changes.origin_en: Linux KFENCE deferrable timer already implemented by the pinned ACK.
changes.adaptation_zh: 采样定时器不再专门叫醒空闲核；启用 CONFIG_KFENCE_DEFERRABLE，保留检测能力。
changes.adaptation_en: Enable CONFIG_KFENCE_DEFERRABLE to avoid waking an idle CPU solely for sampling while retaining detection.
changes.purpose_zh: 采样定时器不再专门叫醒空闲核；启用 CONFIG_KFENCE_DEFERRABLE，保留检测能力。
changes.purpose_en: Enable CONFIG_KFENCE_DEFERRABLE to avoid waking an idle CPU solely for sampling while retaining detection.

changes.origin_zh: Linux ftrace 的 trace_buf_size 启动参数。
changes.origin_en: Linux ftrace trace_buf_size boot parameter.
changes.adaptation_zh: 初始每核 8 KiB，减少自动扩张的内存占用；Perfetto 仍可按需扩容。
changes.adaptation_en: Start at 8 KiB per CPU to limit automatic buffer growth; Perfetto can still resize buffers.
changes.purpose_zh: 初始每核 8 KiB，减少自动扩张的内存占用；Perfetto 仍可按需扩容。
changes.purpose_en: Start at 8 KiB per CPU to limit automatic buffer growth; Perfetto can still resize buffers.

changes.origin_zh: Linux / ACK 的 lazy RCU 与 NOCB 回调卸载机制。
changes.origin_en: Linux/ACK lazy RCU and NOCB callback offloading.
changes.adaptation_zh: 显式启用回调卸载与 lazy 批处理，减少轻负载唤醒；沿用上游的内存压力与紧急刷新路径。
changes.adaptation_en: Explicitly enable offloading and lazy batching to reduce light-load wakeups; retain upstream pressure and urgent flushing.
changes.purpose_zh: 显式启用回调卸载与 lazy 批处理，减少轻负载唤醒；沿用上游的内存压力与紧急刷新路径。
changes.purpose_en: Explicitly enable offloading and lazy batching to reduce light-load wakeups; retain upstream pressure and urgent flushing.

changes.origin_zh: Linux shmem / tmpfs 的扩展属性支持。
changes.origin_en: Linux shmem/tmpfs extended-attribute support.
changes.adaptation_zh: 启用 CONFIG_TMPFS_XATTR，补齐临时文件系统的属性兼容性；不作为性能提升宣称。
changes.adaptation_en: Enable CONFIG_TMPFS_XATTR for temporary-filesystem compatibility; make no performance claim.
changes.purpose_zh: 启用 CONFIG_TMPFS_XATTR，补齐临时文件系统的属性兼容性；不作为性能提升宣称。
changes.purpose_en: Enable CONFIG_TMPFS_XATTR for temporary-filesystem compatibility; make no performance claim.

changes.classification: upstream allocator API plus local adaptation
changes.origin_zh: Linux zram 的后处理候选表与 SLUB 的 KMEM_CACHE 接口；专用缓存接入由本项目实现。
changes.origin_en: Linux zram post-processing records and SLUB KMEM_CACHE API; dedicated-cache integration is implemented here.
changes.adaptation_zh: 用专用小对象缓存保存重压缩 / 写回候选，减少临时分配浪费；创建失败回退 kmalloc，退出时完整释放。
changes.adaptation_en: Use a small-object cache for recompression/writeback candidates; fall back to kmalloc if cache creation fails and release it on teardown.
changes.purpose_zh: 用专用小对象缓存保存重压缩 / 写回候选，减少临时分配浪费；创建失败回退 kmalloc，退出时完整释放。
changes.purpose_en: Use a small-object cache for recompression/writeback candidates; fall back to kmalloc if cache creation fails and release it on teardown.

changes.name_zh: 有预算的系统哈希缓存保留
changes.origin_zh: 一加 dm_bufio_shrink_scan_skip 的低内存回收策略，适配 ACK 6.18 shrink-count 接口。
changes.origin_en: OnePlus dm_bufio_shrink_scan_skip low-memory policy adapted to the ACK 6.18 shrink-count interface.
changes.adaptation_zh: 可用内存超过 10% 且缓存未超预算时少回收；预算最多为总内存 2%，低内存时照常回收，可关闭。
changes.adaptation_en: Retain caches only above 10% available RAM and within a budget capped at 2% of RAM; restore ordinary reclaim under pressure and allow disabling.
changes.purpose_zh: 可用内存超过 10% 且缓存未超预算时少回收；预算最多为总内存 2%，低内存时照常回收，可关闭。
changes.purpose_en: Retain caches only above 10% available RAM and within a budget capped at 2% of RAM; restore ordinary reclaim under pressure and allow disabling.

changes.classification: documented platform APIs plus local recovery policy
changes.origin_zh: KernelSU 模块生命周期与 AOSP 启动原因接口；快照、计时和回退判定由本项目实现。
changes.origin_en: KernelSU module lifecycle and AOSP boot-reason interfaces; snapshots, timing and rollback decisions are implemented here.
changes.adaptation_zh: 修改后试用 120 秒；重启生效项从下次启动计时。仅确认同内核、窗口内 panic / watchdog 才回退，普通重启与内核切换保留设置。
changes.adaptation_en: Trial edits for 120 seconds; boot-only choices start next boot. Roll back only confirmed same-kernel panic/watchdog boots inside the window; preserve choices across normal reboots and kernel changes.
changes.purpose_zh: 修改后试用 120 秒；重启生效项从下次启动计时。仅确认同内核、窗口内 panic / watchdog 才回退，普通重启与内核切换保留设置。
changes.purpose_en: Trial edits for 120 seconds; boot-only choices start next boot. Roll back only confirmed same-kernel panic/watchdog boots inside the window; preserve choices across normal reboots and kernel changes.

selection_decisions.reason: mi_reclaim already supplies watermark boosting and mi_mtmr supplies VIP cache protection; avoid stacking another policy.
BBR, fq_codel and fq are built in; official mibbr is selected. Keep the existing cubic global default and vendor per-application policy.
Additional process residency overlaps VIP protection and requires coordinated folio/MGLRU reclaim behavior.
Do not add an extra filesystem correctness change without reproduction on this pinned kernel.
Upstream already isolates the KFENCE pool; preserve current rodata permissions and hardware-dependent mapping selection.
A second cap can trade anonymous compression for file-cache loss without demonstrated benefit here.

existing_capabilities.scope: Built-in algorithms and selected official module; actual application policy requires device verification.
